reviewNote: Leaders verified 3 Aug 2026 (Burnham UK PM since 20 Jul 2026 — do not cite Starmer; Trump/Vance, Albanese, Modi and Putin re-confirmed against 2026 sources). Elections and successions happen: re-verify each holder whenever a scope=self spike suggests trouble at home.
note: World-leaders tracker. The poller synthesises one Google News query feed per leader (kind gnews, stream 'leaders') AND runs the name rules below over every corpus item, so leader files include coverage from the direct feeds (RNZ, BBC, Al Jazeera...) as well as query-net catches. Every leader item gets exactly ONE scope: 'globe' (what they're doing to the world), 'country' (what they're doing at home), 'self' (what's happening to them — polls, courts, health, party). Scope scoring: seed hits, title x2 + summary x1, highest wins; precedence self > globe > country on ties; no hits = country. Globe detection is leader-relative: mentions of places FOREIGN to the leader's homeTokens (other leaders' homes, the places list, or a second tracked leader) score globe; their own country's institutions score country.

leaders.name: Donald Trump
leaders.note: The alliance-and-tariff variable in every NZ trade and security question; her 'challenge of trusting Trump' file.

socials.evidence: NPR's May 2026 analysis counted ~19 posts/day in early 2026, and Aug 2026 NPR/CNBC coverage of Truth Social's paid early-access feed treats his account as the market-moving source
Account widely cited by news orgs (NBC covered his return post); NPR May 2026 notes he posts almost exclusively on Truth Social, with only occasional X posts (latest found dated May 2026)
Profile billed '45th & 47th President of the United States'; Social Blade/HypeAuditor trackers show ~44M followers with new posts continuing through July 2026
Fortune covered his 2023 reinstatement and return to posting; page shows 42.4M likes and ~486k 'people talking about this', indicating ongoing cross-posted activity
CNBC and Snopes (July 2026) cite it as his official account with 16.7M followers but only 77 videos in total, so posting is sporadic

leaders.socialsNote: Lives on Truth Social, posting many times daily and breaking policy news there first (TMTG now even sells early access to his Truths); X, Instagram and Facebook are secondary, largely cross-posted channels, and TikTok is occasional despite a big following.
